gloss: to pick up; to take in one's hand

definitions.gloss: to pick up; to take in one's hand
definitions.explanation: To pick something up and hold it, especially in order to look at it more closely.

definitions.gloss: (手に取るように) as clearly as if it were in one's hand
definitions.explanation: In the pattern {手|て}に{取|と}るように, to see, hear or understand something perfectly clearly.

examples.japanese: ⟦どうぞ→どうぞ：02920_douzo⟧⟦{自由|じゆう}→自由：01148_jiyuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧お{手|て}に{取|と}って⟦ご{覧|らん}→ご覧：01408_goran⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please feel free to pick them up and have a look.

examples.japanese: ⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{気|き}になった→気になる：03027_kininaru⟧⟦{商品|しょうひん}→商品：01436_shouhin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{手|て}に{取|と}ったら、⟦{思|おも}った→思う：00492_omou⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧⟦{重|おも}かった→重い：00804_omoi⟧。
examples.english: When I picked up the product that had caught my eye in the shop, it was heavier than I expected.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{考|かんが}え→考え：00855_kangae⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{手|て}に{取|と}るよう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{分|わ}かる→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧。
examples.english: I can read his thoughts like an open book.

examples.japanese: ⟦{隣|となり}→隣：01003_tonari⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{会話|かいわ}→会話：01271_kaiwa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{手|て}に{取|と}るよう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{聞|き}こえた→聞こえる：01229_kikoeru⟧。
examples.english: I could hear the conversation in the next room as clearly as if I were in it.

examples.japanese: ⟦{高台|たかだい}→高台：14683_takadai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{登|のぼ}る→登る：00660_noboru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{町|まち}→町：00613_machi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{様子|ようす}→様子：01521_yousu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{手|て}に{取|と}るよう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{見渡|みわた}せた→見渡す：07169_miwatasu⟧。
examples.english: From the top of the hill, I could see the whole town as clearly as if it were laid out in front of me.

notes:
USAGE:
お{手|て}に{取|と}って⟦ご{覧|らん}→ご覧：01408_goran⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧ ("please pick it up and look") is a standard phrase on shop signs and from sales staff. In sense 2 the phrase is fixed as {手|て}に{取|と}るよう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ + a verb of perceiving (⟦{分|わ}かる→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧, ⟦{見|み}える→見える：01165_mieru⟧, ⟦{聞|き}こえる→聞こえる：01229_kikoeru⟧).

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{拾|ひろ}う→拾う：00845_hirou⟧: to pick up something lying on the ground; {手|て}に{取|と}る is picking up to hold and examine
- ⟦{持|も}つ→持つ：00478_motsu⟧: to hold or carry; says nothing about the moment of picking up
